children: Franklin BSP Realty Trust said Richard Byrne has stepped back into the company's top role.

Byrne was reappointed chief executive, succeeding Michael Comparato, who resigned earlier this week. The company on Thursday said Comparato decided to step back from day-to-day executive responsibilities in order to spend more time with his family.
Comparato will transition to a senior advisor role at the company through 2027, Franklin BSP said.

Franklin BSP said Byrne has remained closely involved with the company as chairman of the board. As he steps back into the CEO role, he will be supported by the company's experienced senior leadership team, it added.

Jerry Baglien will continue to serve as the company's finance chief and chief operating officer. He was also appointed co-president, alongside Brian Buffone, and will assume the responsibility of leading Franklin BSP's commercial real estate debt platform.
